video_title: Victor Wembanyama on Team Win and Game Strategy Against the Warriors

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on physical play and safety against Draymond Green
quotes.excerpt: I feel very secure. I know I have to be smart, but I feel very secure.
quotes.quote: I feel very secure. I know I have to be smart, but I feel very secure. It is not a good basketball strategy and it shows. So, I am ready to put my money on the line for the team if that allows us to win by 40.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on involving teammates early in games
quotes.excerpt: Especially against a team like this, we know if we get the guys involved, it is better.
quotes.quote: Especially against a team like this, we know if we get the guys involved, it is better. It is a concerted thing. Sometimes you come out and you see what they are doing, and I want to get the guys involved.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his pre-game physical preparation
quotes.excerpt: There is no better way than throwing the basket to prepare to play basketball.
quotes.quote: There is no better way than throwing the basket to prepare to play basketball. After all the rest is a lot of prevention. In itself, the major part of the time I could come, shoot a few shots and play directly. And sometimes even, we feel so well that there is no need to do that. It is more when there are injuries. There are always small alerts on the body, so the activations are very specific, so that changes. But the most important is what we see on the court.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Il n'y a pas mieux que de shooter au basket pour se préparer à jouer au basket. Après tout le reste, c'est beaucoup de prévention. En soi, la majeure partie du temps, je pourrais venir, shooter quelques tirs et jouer directement. Et parfois même, on se sent tellement bien qu'il n'y a pas besoin de faire ça. C'est plus quand il y a des blessures. Il y a toujours des petites alertes sur le corps, donc les activations sont très spécifiques, donc ça change. Mais le plus important, c'est ce qu'on voit sur le terrain.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the San Antonio community and culture
quotes.excerpt: What I like the most is the respect they carry, that they carry for us.
quotes.quote: What I like the most is the respect they carry, that they carry for us. I am sometimes a bit embarrassed to be put on a pedestal like that. I think it is really the ideal environment because even in other cities where we are not the team, people are not as respectful. People are sometimes insistent or aggressive, but never here. So it is really the ideal environment, it is the ideal environment to spend 15-20 years.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ce qui me plaît le plus, c'est le respect qu'ils portent, qu'ils nous portent. Je suis parfois un peu gêné d'être mis sur un piédestal comme ça. Je pense que c'est vraiment l'environnement idéal parce que même dans les autres villes dont on n'est pas l'équipe, les gens ne sont pas aussi respectueux. Les gens sont parfois insistants ou agressifs, mais jamais ici. Donc c'est vraiment l'environnement idéal, c'est l'environnement idéal pour passer 15-20 ans.
